page.layout: One page of text, one column. Top of the page: a short centred line, possibly a heading. Below: several lines of running text in a single column. No margin notes, running head, or page number visible.
page.notes: The scan resolution is too low to read any word. The letter counts are rough estimates from line length. I could not confirm the head level, paragraph breaks, or whether there is a catchword or signature at the foot. A higher-resolution scan (ideally 300 dpi or more, with the full page visible) would allow a proper transcription.
